name: 先天性大脳白質形成不全症（SOX10型）

sources.title: Peripheral demyelinating neuropathy-central dysmyelinating leukodystrophy-Waardenburg syndrome-Hirschsprung disease

summary.text: Peripheral demyelinating neuropathy-central dysmyelinating leukodystrophy-Waardenburg syndrome-Hirschsprung disease (PCWH) is a systemic disease characterized by the association of the features of Waardenburg-Shah syndrome (WSS) with neurological features of variable severity.
